snippet.title: Young Suns - Release Date Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4149610/Young_Suns/

A release date trailer for Young Suns. Young Suns is a 1-4 player narrative life sim set on Jupiter, in an optimistic alternative future. Visit planetoids, ruins, and stations. Decorate and customize your own spaceship. Help the citizens of Jupiter make society better!
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
